description: Before v6, Anthropic cache-write tokens are only in ai.response.providerMetadata, and the input count is exclusive.
notes: pinned by hand from Langfuse's providerMetadata reading. Confirmed by vercel/v5-anthropic-cache: ai.usage carries the exclusive input 100 and no cache counts, and the cache write 200 is only in ai.response.providerMetadata (D113).
